text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's movements are worse than 
usual. She seemed in poor shape, so I 
suggested wrapping things up early, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...If she is... going to run... then I 
will... as well...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...In the next race... so that I can get 
even a little closer to her 
back............"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......I'm alright. I won't push myself too 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might be pushing Manhattan Cafe too 
hard... I should pay closer attention to 
her schedule.
